Homeowner calendars

Give homeowners a read-only calendar of their own build. Their site only — never your other jobs. Crews show by trade, not by name ("Flooring crew on site Tue–Thu"), and your notes to subs stay private. Homeowners who can see the week ahead call and text far less.
